Enviornments, Memories and Experiences stay with a person, despite the person occupying not nearly the mass nor novelty of these experiences; yet in memory/microkosmo form, we indeed contain this depth. This may be precisely why Psychology and Human-Nature are always at war; One is an Empirical Science founded on the Observable, while the other is a Phenomenological essence which evaporates upon it's observation (This is the nature of experiences. However, with memory we can "re-member" or Re-experience the ephemeral.)
